_comment: FRET > Phasor reference from IRF...: the constants g_irf/s_irf (and n_bg) the corrected phasor equations read, determined from measurements with tttrlib.

sections.label: IRF / reference:
sections.description: TTTR file (.ptu, .ht3, ...) of the instrument response: scatter, a mirror, or a dye of known lifetime.

sections.label: Measurement:
sections.description: Optional: the TTTR file the pixel table was made from; its flat background gives n_bg per pixel and frame.

sections.label: Green channels:
sections.description: Routing channels of the green detectors (empty: skip green).

sections.label: Red channels:
sections.description: Routing channels of the red detectors (empty: skip red).

sections.label: Channels of g, s:
sections.description: Routing channels of the unlabelled g, s columns (empty: skip).

sections.label: Reference lifetime (ns):
sections.description: 0 for scatter / a mirror; the lifetime of a reference dye otherwise.
